name: Rage Suppressant
notes: manticores: lasts while taken regularly; other races: until next breather
text: Developed by the Fury Walkers. Manticores who take it at regular intervals tier up their resists against provocation. Other races only get this until their next breather, unless the medicine is altered to work for their race. Combined with Slow Heart, its effect is doubled, but the user becomes vulnerable to addiction to Slow Heart. Can be crafted as a one-slot augment on a normal potion or as a standalone potion. As a standalone, you make three times the normal amount for the same cost (material and/or DIY).
